IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: SUPPORT RIGOROUS, INTELLECTUALLY OPEN, HONEST STUDY AND DISCUSSION OF INT'L ECONOMIC POLICY.
IRS990.MissionDesc: THE PETERSON INSTITUTE FOR INTERNATIONAL ECONOMICS (PIIE) IS AN INDEPENDENT NONPROFIT, NONPARTISAN RESEARCH ORGANIZATION DEDICATED TO STRENGTHENING PROSPERITY AND HUMAN WELFARE IN THE GLOBAL ECONOMY THROUGH EXPERT ANALYSIS AND PRACTICAL POLICY SOLUTIONS.
IRS990.Desc: RESEARCH: THE INSTITUTE'S RESEARCH TEAM PROVIDED OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS AND PRACTICAL PUBLIC POLICY RECOMMENDATIONS ON TOPICS INCLUDING INTERNATIONAL TRADE, INVESTMENTS, FINANCE AND TAX POLICY; MACROECONOMICS; GLOBALIZATION AND HUMAN WELFARE; CLIMATE CHANGE; CYBERSECURITY; ECONOMIC SANCTIONS; ECONOMIC NATIONALISM; GLOBAL SUPPLY CHAINS; MONETARY AND FISCAL POLICY; CRITICAL MINERALS; THE ECONOMIC RAMIFICATIONS OF INTERNATIONAL CONFLICTS; THE ECONOMIC IMPLICATIONS OF TECHNOLOGICAL ADVANCES, ESPECIALLY IN ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE; AND ECONOMIC ISSUES IN THE UNITED STATES SPECIFICALLY RELATED TO CHINA, EUROPEAN UNION, INDIA, JAPAN, KOREA, LATIN AMERICA, THE MIDDLE EAST NORTH AFRICA (MENA), RUSSIA, THE UNITED KINGDOM, AND THE UNITED STATES-MEXICO-CANADA TRADING BLOC.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: OUTREACH: THE INSTITUTE HOSTED NUMEROUS PUBLIC EVENTS, IN-PERSON AND ONLINE, IN WASHINGTON, D.C. AND AROUND THE WORLD, TO SHARE OUR RESEARCH AND INVITE DISCUSSION. WE HOLD THESE SESSIONS TO INFORM A BROAD RANGE OF INTERESTED PARTIES AND ENCOURAGE VIGOROUS DEBATE AND EXCHANGE OF DIFFERENT POINTS OF VIEWS TO ENRICH THE BROADER POPULATION'S UNDERSTANDING OF COMPLEX ISSUES. PARTICIPANTS INCLUDED PIIE SCHOLARS AND OUTSIDE EXPERTS FROM ACADEMIA, THINK TANKS, EMBASSIES, GOVERNMENT, AND ORGANIZATIONS INCLUDING THE INTERNATIONAL MONETARY FUND, THE WORLD BANK, THE WORLD TRADE ORGANIZATION, THE BANK FOR INTERNATIONAL SETTLEMENTS, THE COUNCIL ON FOREIGN RELATIONS, AND THE WORLD ECONOMIC FORUM. THE AUDIENCE FOR THESE EVENTS CAME, SIMILARLY, FROM ACADEMIA, BUSINESS, GOVERNMENT, INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS, AND THE MEDIA.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: PUBLICATIONS: TO SHARE THE INSTITUTE'S RESEARCH WITH THE WIDEST POSSIBLE AUDIENCE, PIIE PUBLISHED OUR WORK ON OUR WEBSITE IN VARIOUS FORMATS, INCLUDING RESEARCH PAPERS, CHARTS, BLOGPOSTS, PODCASTS, AND VIDEO INTERVIEWS, ALL AVAILABLE TO THE PUBLIC. WE DISTRIBUTED THE WORK FURTHER THROUGH OUR WEEKLY EMAIL NEWSLETTER AND ON SOCIAL MEDIA. WE RECORDED MILLIONS OF PIIE.COM WEB VIEWS AND MORE THAN 100,000 FOLLOWERS OF OUR VARIOUS SOCIAL MEDIA ACCOUNTS. INSTITUTE SCHOLARS ALSO WROTE OPINION ARTICLES FOR OUTSIDE PUBLICATIONS, GAVE SPEECHES TO VARIOUS GATHERINGS, AND PROVIDED EXPERT TESTIMONY AT THE INVITATION OF US AND OTHER GOVERNMENT OFFICES. PIIE EXPERTS GAVE NUMEROUS INTERVIEWS TO JOURNALISTS AND WERE CITED BY MAJOR US AND INTERNATIONAL MEDIA, AS WELL AS BY REGIONAL AND LOCAL AMERICAN NEWS OUTLETS. OUR SCHOLARS SHARED THEIR FINDINGS WITH THE PUBLIC VIA TELEVISION, RADIO, ONLINE, TELEPHONE, EMAIL, IN PRINT, AND VIA NEWSWIRE SERVICES.

ProgSrvcAccomActyOtherGrp.Desc: COMMUNICATIONS: THE INSTITUTE CREATES AUDIOVISUAL MATERIALS, INTERACTIVE GRAPHICS, EMAIL NEWSLETTERS, EDUCATIONAL MATERIALS, AND SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT TO DEEPEN THE PUBLIC'S AND POLICYMAKERS' UNDERSTANDING OF THE INTERNATIONAL ECONOMIC ISSUES DISCUSSED.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE INSTITUTE'S ENDOWMENT CONSISTS OF FUNDS ESTABLISHED TO SUPPORT THE SALARY AND RESEARCH COSTS OF SENIOR FELLOWS AND OTHER INITIATIVES AND INCLUDES BOTH DONOR-RESTRICTED ENDOWMENT FUNDS AND FUNDS DESIGNATED BY THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS TO FUNCTION AS ENDOWMENTS. THE ENDOWMENT IS THE CORE SOURCE OF OPERATIONAL FUNDS, INDEPENDENT FROM AND NOT RELIANT UPON EXTERNAL REVENUE SOURCES. ACCORDINGLY, THE SPENDING AND INVESTMENT POLICIES ARE DESIGNED IN TANDEM TO EARN AND PROVIDE SUSTAINABLE AND RELIABLE AMOUNTS ANNUALLY TO SUPPORT THE INSTITUTE'S PROGRAMS.

THE INSTITUTE EVALUATED ITS UNCERTAINTY IN INCOME TAXES FOR THE YEARS ENDED JUNE 30, 2025 AND 2024, AND DETERMINED THAT THERE WERE NO MATTERS THAT WOULD REQUIRE RECOGNITION IN THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS OR THAT MAY HAVE ANY EFFECT ON ITS TAX-EXEMPT STATUS.

IN ACCORDANCE WITH IRS INSTRUCTIONS, ALL AMOUNTS REPORTED IN PART I OF SCHEDULE F ARE REPORTED USING THE ACCRUAL BASIS OF ACCOUNTING WHICH IS THE SAME METHOD OF ACCOUNTING USED IN THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 1A
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE BOARD HAS DELEGATED BROAD AUTHORITIES TO ACT ON BEHALF OF THE GOVERNING BODY TO AN EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE COMPRISED OF SELECTED BOARD MEMBERS. THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE MAY EXERCISE THE FULL AUTHORITY OF THE BOARD BETWEEN MEETINGS OF THE BOARD WHEN PROMPT ACTION IS NECESSARY AND ACTION BY THE FULL BOARD IS IMPRACTICABLE OR AS DELEGATED BY THE BOARD, EXCEPT THAT THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE SHALL NOT HAVE THE POWER TO APPROVE A DISSOLUTION OR MERGER, OR THE SALE OF ALL OR SUBSTANTIALLY ALL OF THE INSTITUTE'S ASSETS; APPOINT OR REMOVE DIRECTORS; APPOINT OR REMOVE COMMITTEE MEMBERS; AUTHORIZE DISTRIBUTIONS; OR AMEND THE ARTICLES OF INCORPORATION OR THE BYLAWS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE PRESIDENT AND TREASURER THOROUGHLY REVIEW THE FEDERAL FORM 990, WHICH IS THEN PRESENTED TO THE AUDIT COMMITTEE, THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE, AND THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS BEFORE FILING WITH THE INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: ALL EMPLOYEES MUST DISCLOSE AN ACTUAL OR PERCEIVED CONFLICT OF INTEREST TO HUMAN RESOURCES AND/OR THE PRESIDENT BEFORE ENGAGING IN THE CONFLICTING ACTIVITY, OR AS SOON AS AN EMPLOYEE BECOMES AWARE OF SUCH CONFLICT. IN ADDITION, AT THE TIME OF HIRE, AND AT LEAST ANNUALLY THEREAFTER AS REQUESTED, ALL EMPLOYEES ARE REQUIRED TO REPORT OUTSIDE INCOME OR BUSINESS RELATIONSHIPS OR OTHER POTENTIAL CONFLICTS OF INTEREST, PARTICULARLY FINANCIAL ACTIVITIES THAT MAY REFLECT ADVERSELY ON RESEARCH INDEPENDENCE. WHEN POTENTIAL CONFLICTS EXIST, THE PERSON WITH THE CONFLICT IS PROHIBITED FROM PARTICIPATING IN THE GOVERNING BODY'S DELIBERATIONS AND DECISIONS IN THE TRANSACTIONS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
